description: Cancel a broadcast that has not been fanned out. ⚠️ Rows ALREADY queued are deliberately NOT withdrawn — pulling messages out from under the send loop is a different, riskier operation than abandoning a draft. So this stops a broadcast from starting; it does not reliably stop one already in flight.

workspace.description: Tenant to target (cli_…). Omit to use the active/bound workspace. list_workspaces shows the options.

name: send_cancel_broadcast
